a: निपा — {c2c} P. 1 To drink or suck in, imbibe. --2 To absorb, dry up. --3 To drink, kiss; अत एव निपीयतेऽधरः Pt. 1. 189; दंतच्छदं प्रियतमेन निपीतसारं Rs. 4. 13. --4 To feast on (with the eyes or ears).

a: निपाकः — Maturing, ripening.

a milk-pail, L.

m: नि-˚पात m. falling down, descending, alighting (lit. and fig.), falling from (abl.) into or upon (comp.), rushing upon, attacking (comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
decay, destruction, ruin, death, ib.
(from the Caus.) casting, hurling, discharging, Kum. iii, 15
accidental occurrence or mention, Nir.; ĀśvŚr.
(in gram.) irregular form, irregularity, exception (cf. पर-, पूर्व-)
a particle (all adverbs including conjunctions and interjections), Nir.; Prāt.; Pāṇ. i, 4, 56
नि-पात See under नि-पत्.
a: निपातः — 1 Falling or coming down, descending, alighting; पयोधरोत्सेधनिपातचूर्णिताः Ku. 5. 24; Rs. 5. 4. --2 Attacking, falling upon, a spring, leap; R. 2. 60. --3 Casting, hurling, discharging; Ku. 3. 15. --4 Descent, fall; निशितनिपाताः शराः Ś. 1. 10. --5 Dying, death; Ms. 6. 31. --6 Accidental occurrence or mention. --7 An irregular form, irregularity, putting down as irregular or exceptional; एते निपाताः, निपातोयं &c. --8 A particle, an indeclinable; see P. I. 4. 56. --9 The opposite extremity, the lower end.

m: नि-˚पातक ifc. = पातक, a bad deed, a sin, MBh. v, 4053.
a: निपातकः — --कं Sin, a bad act.

m: नि-˚पातनीय mfn. to be caused to fall
नि-˚पातनीय m. (with दण्ड m. ‘punishment must be inflicted’), Sāh.

s: klI, (nipAtyate'neneti । ni + pata + Ric + karaRe lyuw .) KalIkAraH । iti BarataH ॥ aDonayanam । iti sarvvasvam । tatparyyAyaH । avanAyaH 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 29 ॥ niyAtanam 3 । iti nayanAnandaH ॥ vyAkaraRalakzaRAnutpannapadasADanam । yaTA, nipAtanAdizwasidDiH । yallakzaRenAnutpannaM tat sarvvaM nipAtanAt sidDamiti BAzyam ॥ nipAtalakzaRaM yaTA, “varRAgamo varRaviparyyayaSca dvO cAparO varRavikAranASO । DAtostadarTAtiSayena yogastaducyate paYcaviDaM niruktam ॥ iti prAYcaH .” iti durgAdAsaH ॥ tadyaTA, -- “varRAgamo gavendrAdO siMhe varRaviparyyayaH । zoqaSAdO vikAraH syAt varRanASaH pfzodare ॥” iti kalApapaYjI ॥
v: nipAtana

m: नि-˚पातन mfn. (fr. Caus.) throwing down, killing, destroying, knocking out (an eye), MBh.
नि-˚पातन n. causing to descend or fall, throwing down, letting drop or sink, Mn.; Yājñ.; R. (cf. दण्ड-न्˚)
putting on, applying (as a knife), touching with (comp.), Suśr.
overthrowing, destroying, killing, Mn.; MBh.
(in gram.) accidental mention or use of a word, putting down as an irregularity
an irregular form or exception, Prāt.; Pāṇ., Sch.; Vop.
= नि-पतन, falling down (of a fire-brand), Yājñ. i, 145
alighting (said of a bird), Pañc. ii, 57.
a: निपातन — a. Killing, destroying. --नं 1 Throwing down, beating or knocking down; Ms. 11. 209. --2 Overthrowing, destroying, killing. --3 Touching with. --4 Putting down as irregular or exceptional. --5 An irregular form of a word, irregularity, exception. --6 Falling or flying down.

m: नि-˚पात—प्रतीकार m. the repelling of assaults, ib.

falling or alighting on (comp. Ragh. ix, 40; उपरि, Vikr. v, 15)
striking down, destroying, MBh.; Ragh.
a: निपातिन् — a. 1 Falling down, alighting; R. 9. 41. --2 Destroyed, decayed. --3 Destroying; R. 11. 21.

(in gram.) irregular, exceptional.
a: निपातित — a. 1 Thrown or put down, felled. --2 Killed, destroyed. --3 Beaten down. --4 Irregular.

m: नि-˚पीडना f. oppression, Sāh.

नि-˚परण n. the putting down or offering (of rice &c. to deceased relatives), Nir.; ĀśvŚr., Sch.

नि-√ पत् P. -पतति (ep. also ˚ते), to fly down, settle down, descend on (loc.), alight, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to rush upon, attack, assail (acc. or loc.), Ratnāv.; Kathās.; to fall down, fall upon or into (lit. and fig., with उपरि, acc. or loc.; with पादयोः, to throw one's self at a person's [gen.] feet, Kum.; Kathās.); to fall into ruin or decay, be lost, AV.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.; to be miscarried (as the fetus), BhP.; to befall, happen, take place, occur, fall to the share of (loc.), Mn.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.; to enter, be inserted, get a place, Pāṇ.; Nir. : Caus. -पातयति (aor. -अपीपतत्, RV.), to cause to fall down, or on (loc.), throw down, fell, kill, destroy, RV. &c. &c.; to spit out, Pañc. iii, 60; to inlay, emboss, MBh. iv, 1325; to fix (the teeth) in (loc.), MBh.; to direct (the eyes) towards (loc.), MārkP.; to impute (a fault) to (gen.), Kathās.; to raise (taxes) from (abl.), MBh.; (in gram.) to put down as a special or irregular form, consider as anomalous or irregular.
a: निपत् — {c1c} P. 1 To fall or come down, descend, alight, sink down; निपतंती पतिमप्यपातयत् R. 8. 38; Bk. 15. 27. --2 To be cast at, be directed to wards; R. 6. 11. --3 To throw oneself down (as at the feet), fall prostrate; देवास्तदंते हरमूढभार्यं किरीटबद्धांजलयो निपत्य Ku. 7. 92; R. 4. 50; Bh. 2. 31. --4 To fall or descend into, meet in; R. 10. 26. --5 To fall upon, attack, rush at or upon; सिंहो शिशुरपि निपतति मदमलिनकपोलभित्तिषु गजेषु Bh. 2. 38. --6 To happen, occur, take place, fall to one's lot; सकृदंशो निपतति Ms. 9. 47. --7 To be placed, occupy a place; अभ्यर्हितं पूर्वं निपतति. --8 To flow in, discharge into. --9 To fall into ruin. --10 To fall into (any state). --Caus. 1 To cause to fall down, throw or hurl down. --2 To kill, destroy; तातं निपात्य सह बंधुजनाक्षितोयैः Mu. 5. 7, Pt. 3. 63. --3 To inlay, emboss. --4 To direct (the eyes) upon. --5 To spit out. --6 To raise or levy (as a tribute). --7 (In gram.) To put down as a special or irregular form, to mention as an irregular formation; एते पंचविंशतिरजंता निपात्यंते Sk.

m: नि-˚पतन n. falling down, falling, descending, MBh.; Hariv.
(गर्भिण्यागर्भस्य) the lying-in of a pregnant woman, VarBṛS. li, 35
flying, MBh.
a: निपतनं — 1 Falling down, descending, alighting. --2 Flying down.

m: नि-˚पतित mfn. flown or fallen down, descended (नभो-न्˚, from heaven), fallen upon or into (loc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
decayed, sunk, withered, Dhūrtas.

s: strI, (nipatatyasyAmiti । ni + pata + “saMjYAyAM samajanizadanipateti .” 3 । 3 । 99 । iti kyap । tatazwAp .) yudDaBUmiH । iti mugDaboDawIkAyAM durgAdAsaH ॥ (picCilA BUmiH । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥)

strI nipatyasyAm ni + pata--ADAre kyap ni॰ । 1 picCilaBUmO 2 yudDaBUmO ca ।
m: नि-˚पत्या f. any slippery ground
a field of battle, L.
a: निपत्या — 1 Slippery ground. --2 A battle-field.

m: नि-˚पत्य ind. having fallen down &c., MBh.

v: nipatyarohiRI
strI nipatya rohiRI rohitavarRA strI mayU॰ । nipatyarohitavarRAyAM striyAm
m: नि-˚पत्य—रोहिणी f. (prob.) falling and ascending g. मयूर-व्यंसकादि.
नि-˚पृत (ĀśvŚr.) and नि-˚पूर्त (Pat.) mfn. put down, poured out, offered.
नि-पित्सु mfn. (√ पत् Desid.) going or about to fall, Hariv.
नि-पिष्ट mfn. (√ पिष्) crushed, destroyed, AV.
नि-√ प्रथ् (Caus. aor. -पप्रथन्), to spread or increase, RV. ii, 11, 8.
नि-प्र-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to hurt or destroy (with gen.), Pāṇ. ii, 3, 56, Kāś.
नि-प्रयत्न w.r. for निष्-प्र्˚, Hariv.
नि-प्रियाय (fr. नि-प्रिय) Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to keep in one's possession, not to be willing to give up (acc.), AV.
निपु m. N. of a man, Kṣitīś.

v: nipuRa

tri॰ ni + puRa--ka । 1 pravIRe kriyAsu dakze “SilpopacArayuktASca nipuRAH paRyayozitaH” manuH । “SaktirnipuRatA lokaSAstrakAvyAdyavekzaRAt” kAvyapra॰ 2 sUkzme “duzyaM vaco mama paraM nipuRaM viBAvya” raGunATaH । SreRyAdi॰ aBUtatadBAve'rTe kftAdinA sa॰ । nipuRakfta nipuRIkfte “sADu nipuRAByAmAsevAyAM saptamyaprateH” pA॰ etadyoge arcAyAM gamyamAnAyAM saptamI mAtari nipuRaH । pratyAdiyoge tu na, mAtaraM prati nipuRaH” si॰ kO॰ ।
m: निपुण mf(आ)n. (said to be from a √ पुण्), clever, adroit, skilful, sharp, acute, Mn.; MBh.; Suśr.; Kāv. &c.
skilled in, conversant with, capable of (mostly comp. [cf. Pāṇ. ii, 1, 31 and g. शौण्डादि]; but also infin. [Kāv.] loc. [Var.] gen. [Vop. v, 29] or instr. [Pāṇ. ii, 1, 31])
kind or friendly towards (loc. or प्रति, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 43)
delicate, tender, Jātakam.
perfect, complete, absolute (as purity, devotion &c.), Mn.; BhP.
a: निपुण — a. 1 Clever, sharp, shrewd, skilful; वयस्य निसर्गनिपुणाः स्त्रियः M. 3. --2 Proficient or skilled in, conversant or familiar with (with loc. or instr.); वाचि निपुणः; वाचा निपुणः. --3 Experienced. --4 Kindly or friendly towards. --5 Acute, fine, delicate, minute, sharp. --6 Complete, perfect, accurate. --णं ind. or निपुणेन 1 Skilfully, cleverly. --2 Perfectly, completely, totally. --3 Exactly, carefully, accurately, minutely; निपुणमन्विष्यन्नुपलब्धवान् Dk. 59. --4 In a delicate manner.

k.v: प्रवीणे निपुणाभिज्ञविज्ञनिष्णातशिक्षिताः। वैज्ञानिकः कृतमुखः कृती कुशल इत्यपि॥

m: निपुण—दृश् mfn. sharp-sighted, clever, knowing, MW.
निपुणम् ind. in a clever or delicate manner, MBh.; Kāv.
completely, perfectly, absolutely, exactly, precisely, R. (also निपुण ibc. Pāṇ. vi, 2, 24, and ˚णेन, MBh.; BhP.)
निपुण—ता f. skilfulness, adroitness, carefulness, accuracy, Kāv.; Pañc.
a: निपुणता --त्वं — 1 Skilfulness, cleverness. --2 Carefulness, accuracy.

m: निपुण—तर mfn. more clever or perfect &c.
निपुण—तरम् ind. = next, Pañc.
निपुण—तस् ind. wholly, completely, MBh.
निपुणि m. or f. N. of an evil demon, Hir.
निपुणिका f. N. of a waiting-maid, Kālid.
नि-√ पुथ् Caus. -पोथयति, to dash down, Hariv.
नि-पुर् f. the subtle body, VS.; AV. (= सूक्ष्म-देह, Mahīdh.)
